name: Cultist: Shadow Words boosts the Whispers family by 25% through a native SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS spell mod (#3106)
contract: 706928 is SpellFamilyName 31, effect0 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue=8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), BasePoints=24 -> CalcValue 25, SpellClassMask [0,0,16] (dword2 bit4). Every Whispers of N'Zoth/Y'shaarj/Yogg-Saron/C'thun rank (e.g. 561386, 561389, 572637, 572791) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags[2]=16, an exact classmask match; the similarly-named 807512 ("Whispers of C'Thun", capitalized differently) carries SpellFamilyFlags[2]=0 and is not matched, used here as a same-family near-miss control. Player::ApplySpellMod resolves a percent SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS mod as basevalue*(1+0.25) with zero custom C++ (Player.cpp ~10275). Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.

steps.label: SETUP: Whispers of N'Zoth is unmodified before Shadow Words
Shadow Words adds 25% to Whispers of N'Zoth (#3106)
Shadow Words adds 25% to Whispers of C'thun too (#3106)
Shadow Words adds 25% to Whispers of Yogg-Saron too (#3106)
Shadow Words leaves the differently-classmasked 'Whispers of C'Thun' (807512) alone (near-miss control)
